$comment: Bridle toolchain pins: the single source of truth. Bump rule: edit a pin here, mirror rust.channel / rust.components / rust.targets into rust-toolchain.toml and node.major into .node-version, reinstall the tool with the command in docs/ops/toolchain.md, then run `bash tools/doctor.sh` (it fails on drift between this file and the two mirrors). CI reads pins with jq, e.g. `jq -r .tools.rust.channel tools/toolchain.json`. The keys of `tools` are the doctor's row names.
